title: The Buoys After the Storm
story: Last night's gale sent lobster buoys bobbing all over the harbor, from Seal Ledge clear to the ferry dock. Otis spent the morning fishing them out with a boat hook, whistling a shanty slightly off-key. Three of the strays belong to three different lobstermen, and the harbor log has to say who fishes where. Whose buoy is whose, and where does each of them fish?

texts: The owner of the striped buoy fishes at neither Gull Rock nor East Cove.
The lobsterman who fishes at East Cove owns either the checkered or the striped buoy.
Oscar owns either the checkered or the striped buoy.
The owner of the checkered buoy is either Nico or Oscar.
Oscar does not fish at East Cove.

trace.text: The striped buoy must go with the Narrows: clue 1 rules out Gull Rock and East Cove.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The orange buoy must go with Gull Rock: clue 2 rules out East Cove; the Narrows already goes with the striped buoy.
The checkered buoy must go with East Cove: the other choices are already taken.
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Oscar must go with the striped buoy: clue 3 rules out the orange buoy; the checkered buoy is already ruled out for East Cove.
The Narrows goes with the striped buoy, so the Narrows also goes with Oscar.
Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Pablo must go with the orange buoy: clue 4 rules out the checkered buoy; the striped buoy already goes with Oscar.
Nico must go with the checkered buoy: the other choices are already taken.
Nico must go with East Cove: Gull Rock is already ruled out for the orange buoy; the Narrows already goes with Oscar.
Pablo must go with Gull Rock: the other choices are already taken.
